notes.title: Update: Version 1.07 Controller Support / Summer Sale Announcement
notes.content:
Thank you for playing MASAGORO.
We have added support for controllers, which we announced at the time of release as one of our future plans.
In addition, we are offering a 15% discount on MASAGORO during summer sale.

[h1]Added Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Controller support
[/list] 
The game now supports controller operation.
For more information about the control keys, please refer to the "How to operate" section in the game.

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the bathroom door to disappear under certain circumstances.
[/list]

tags.bug: [*] Fixed a bug that caused the bathroom door to disappear under certain circumstances.

notes.title: Several fatal bugs have been fixed.(2021/03/27)
notes.content:
Thank you for playing MASAGORO.
The following bugs have been fixed today.
[list]
[*] Fixed a problem where the map would keep appearing if you pressed the Q button while the item screen was displayed after picking up an item.
[*] Fixed a problem where the sound of breathing would be lost when restarting after a game over.
[*] Fixed some typos in the text.
[/list]
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
We will continue to fix fatal bugs as soon as they are found.
